statements.impact_statement: Trivy 0.67.2 reports no vulnerable Pygments in this image; the runtime carries Pygments 2.21.0, above the 2.20.0 fixed version that the previous candidate image reported as affected.
statements.action_statement: Reassess if the locked Pygments dependency changes or if the image is rebuilt from a different source revision. This statement is a technical assessment, not a waiver and not an operator approval.

statements.impact_statement: Trivy 0.67.2 reports no vulnerable python-dotenv in this image; the runtime carries python-dotenv 1.2.4, above the 1.2.2 fixed version that the previous candidate image reported as affected. The declared floor in pyproject.toml was raised from 1.1.1 to 1.2.2 so a future re-resolve cannot silently reintroduce the affected line.
statements.action_statement: Reassess if the locked python-dotenv dependency changes or if the image is rebuilt from a different source revision. This statement is a technical assessment, not a waiver and not an operator approval.
